review: All exact (sympy): for a generic rational frame with symbolic rates and a symbolic antisymmetric rotation rate, a label-dependent rotation of the coin axes shifts K = Edot E^-1/w by E (Rdot^T R) E^-1/w, exactly antisymmetric once lowered with the metric, while sym(gK) = -gdot/(2w); so only c1 = c2 survives and the blind family is block 62's (alpha, beta); the isotropic stretch carries (12 alpha + 36 beta) lamdot^2 = block 60 T5's c_k; block 62 T4's 7x7 determinant reproduced up to a constant; at beta = -alpha the gradient relabelling in the label with u -> u - (2 alpha/K) zeta'' changes the quadratic Lagrangian by the total derivative -2 alpha d(zeta' R_1)/dt (symbolic functions of the label), and only then; transverse relabellings cost 2 alpha p^2 |xi'|^2 for every (alpha, beta); alpha = K/4 (the walker's top speed) is not fixed by any clause.
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 2: Does blindness fix the kinetic numbers as it fixed the potential?. SETTING (blocks 53-65 of the source-link direction; open PRs #8568, #8570, #8571, #8573, #8578, #8579, #8581, #8590, #8591, #8592, #8593, #8595 #8596; all rest on SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; read the notes on those PR branches before starting, in particular blocks 62-65). Block 54's walk H = sum_a sigma_a S_a, S_a = (T_a - T_a^dagger)/(2i), the qubit as coin. Block 62: a frame for the coin; uniform frame H^2 = g^ij sin k_i sin k_j. Block 63 (exact identities, every state): the momentum density pi_j = Re psi^dagger S_j psi is conserved with a three-site BOND current J_a^j(x -> x+e_a) = (1/2) Re[psi^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a (S_j psi)(x) + (S_j psi)^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a psi(x)]; a relabelling G_xi = (1/2) sum {xi_j, S_j} generates i[H, G_xi] = sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[d_a xi_j], S_j} (C_a[v] the symmetric hop along a weighted by the bond function v): second-neighbour reach; for a plane-wave pair J = exp(i q_a/2) cos(kbar_a) Theta (Theta the site response); d(psi^dagger sigma_c psi)/dt = 2 sum eps_cad Theta_d^a - [b_c(x) - b_c(x - e_c)], b_c = Re psi^dagger(x) psi(x+e_c). Block 64: strains B_a^j on bonds with H[B] = H + sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[B_a^j], S_j}; curls F_ab^j = d_a B_b^j - d_b B_a^j blind to relabellings; field equations of any function of the curls divergence-free; among two-derivative densities of a frame, POINTWISE blindness to e -> R(x) e leaves det e and D* = det e [T1/4 + T2/2 - T3] - 2 div(det e V) = -sqrt(g) R[e^T e], so with F = sum_x w_x D_x (block 60) beta = 1 is forced; T5: the response to a rotation of a site's three forward bonds, J_a^j(x) - J_j^a(x), is non-zero on stationary states. Block 65: -(i/2)[theta.sigma, H] = (1/2) sum_j {(theta x e_j).sigma, S_j} + (1/2) sum_a C_a[d_a theta_a]; the blind walk H[vartheta] with that scalar hop; response (1/2) d(psi^dagger sigma_c psi)/dt, zero on stationary states; first order around the identity frame only. Exact arithmetic wherever a statement is claimed (Gaussian rationals; the exactly stationary state on a 4x4x4 torus with wave numbers pi/2 and coins (1,1), (1,i), (1,0) is a useful tool); floating point only as evidence, labelled so. TASK: block 64 fixed the potential part of the field's energy by (i) counting it per local tick and (ii) pointwise blindness to a varying rotation of the coin axes. Do the same for the kinetic part. (a) With the frame's rate of change K^j_k = e^a_k (de^j_a/dt)/w, the local quadratic invariants are tr(K^T K), tr(K^2), (tr K)^2, each times det e / w. Show that blindness to a rotation of the coin axes that varies in the LABEL as well as in place removes the antisymmetric part of K and leaves block 62's two numbers (alpha, beta_kin). (b) For h = 2 lam delta the kinetic term is (12 alpha + 36 beta_kin)(dlam/dt)^2: relate to block 60 T5(b) (uniform motion of a closed lattice iff c_k < 0) and to block 62 T4 (at beta_kin = -alpha the mode determinant vanishes identically: which relabellings in the label become symmetries, and on which constraint surface?). (c) Is there any demand in the framework's vocabulary that fixes beta_kin/alpha or alpha/K (disturbances at the walker's top speed)? Report what remains declared.
